code_boundary_review.reviewer: br06_theory; independent of R1 adapter author vigilode_review
code_boundary_review.dyadic_formula: Checked two substitutions x=y/2 and x=(1+y)/2. Powers give exactly 2^(-j-k-1); the first sum expands (1+(1-y))^k and the second expands (1+y)^j. Both sums use old moments, all coefficients are nonnegative, and no interval of birth age is discarded.
code_boundary_review.chronological_source: With u=1-x, j(u)=left*x+right*(1-x); code uses left*J10+right*J01 and leaves physical dt outside.
code_boundary_review.width_gate: Code forms width with sub_up and tolerance with mul_down/add_down using nonnegative lower endpoint. Thus admitted width is no larger than abs_tol+rel_tol*the enclosed true nonnegative moment. Actual directed primitive correctness is an upstream obligation; Decimal checks are independent finite numerical evidence.
code_boundary_review.positivity_intersection: Intersecting an interval enclosure with [0,infinity) preserves enclosure because the exact integral is nonnegative. Entirely negative intervals are refused.
code_boundary_review.input_domain: Finite nonnegative tau and tolerances are checked. j,k are limited to <=2. Halving large finite tau by exactly representable powers of two gives a small argument; no large-tau cutoff or cohort replacement occurs.
code_boundary_review.limitation: A successful direct core interval can be extremely wide. Containment alone does not meet an accuracy tolerance. Only dyadic outputs go through the adapter width gate.

scope_limits: This receipt covers scalar normalized damped moments J_jk for j,k<=2 on the declared 14-point tau grid and three adapter unit tests.
No universal interval guarantee for the entire variable-geometry source operator, no whole-history convergence and no complete VigilODE workspace readiness are inferred.
Direct kernel containment without a useful width is not an accuracy certificate; nine nonfinite tau=1e12 direct refusals remain failures of that direct route.
The BR06 source-native matrix, recovered exact V2 path core, and fresh C9 thin probe are separately verified by their own evidence.
The adapter is an explicit recovery reconstruction R1; no pre-interruption PASS is inherited.
